resources.string: Move slowly along the walls. Point at the floor and ceiling too.
Keyframe limit reached. Finish and start a new scan for the rest of the room.
Camera permission is needed to scan.
The camera is in use, for example by the web page or another app. Close it there, then start the scan again.
ARCore is not available on this device.
Google Play Services for AR is not installed and cannot be installed here.
Move the phone slowly to start tracking
Too dark: turn on more lights
Not enough detail: aim at textured surfaces
Record compass, orientation, light and pressure
Record approximate location (sun and true north)
Sensors off: nothing from them is saved
Heading: this phone has no rotation sensor
Location permission was not granted. The scan continues without location.
The page asked to save your approximate location with this scan. It is used to correct the compass to true north when the scan is processed. You can switch it off while scanning.
Tap the floor line at the base of the boundary, not the glass. Then press Confirm. Scanning continues.
Tap the floor line at the other end of the base, then Confirm.
Height %1$.2f m from the ceiling plane
Tracking is not ready. Move the phone slowly and try again.
Nothing found there. Aim at the floor.
Not a floor plane. Aim at the floor, not at a wall or glass.
Something is in front of the floor there. Aim at bare floor.
That is above the floor. Aim at the floor itself.
Too near or too far. Stand 0.5 to 4 m from the spot on the floor.
The two points are too close together.
The two points are more than 50 m apart.
The two points are at different floor heights.
The limit of 200 marks is reached.
Height must be 0.1 to 10 m. Fix or clear it.
That ray is too flat and may pass through glass. Stand closer and aim down at the floor line.
Point shown in the camera view. Press Confirm, or tap again to move it.
